heading: Today
text: Mostly sunny and cool.  Highs in the 60s north, upper 60s to low 70s south.  Winds northwest near 10 mph from the Green Mountains west, 10 to 15 mph, gusting up to 25 mph east.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear and chilly.  Areas of dense valley fog.  Lows in the 40s, with some 30s in the colder mountain valleys.  Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Saturday
text: Areas of dense valley fog burning off by mid-morning.  Sunshine, mixing with increasing afternoon clouds in NY, and south of I-89.  Warmer.  Highs in the low to mid 70s.  Light winds, becoming south up to 10 mph east, and 10 to 15, gusting to 25 mph through the Champlain Valley.
